assistant.title: Nutrition assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask about food, cooking and feeding your family. Answers come only from NutriFlow's own recipes, tips and guides, with the sources shown.
assistant.disclaimer: This assistant does not replace a doctor. For a sick child, a pregnant woman or any serious symptom, see a doctor. In an emergency, go to the nearest clinic or hospital right away.
assistant.empty_title: What would you like to know?
assistant.empty_text: Ask in Arabic or English. Short, specific questions work best.
suggestions: How can I cook lentils without a fridge and save them for the next day?
How do I prepare oral rehydration solution for a child with diarrhea?
What can I feed a toddler when food is limited?
How can someone with diabetes eat when food is scarce?
How do I make clean water safe to drink when fuel is short?
assistant.input_hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
assistant.stopped: Stopped before the answer was finished.

chat.greeting: Hello! I can help with food, nutrition and safe water, especially when ingredients are limited. You could ask, for example: how do I make water safe to drink, what should I do if my child has diarrhoea, or how do I keep cooked food safe without a fridge?
chat.thanks: You're welcome! Ask me anything else about food, nutrition or safe water.
chat.emergency: This sounds like it may need urgent medical care. Please go to the nearest clinic or medical point right now, or ask the people around you to help you get there. Do not wait and do not try to treat this at home with food or drinks.
chat.emergencyDoctors: You can also find doctors in the Doctors page of this app.
chat.noContext: I could not find reliable information about this in my sources, so I would rather not guess. Try asking in a different way, or ask a doctor or a nutrition worker at the nearest medical point.
chat.outOfScope: I can only help with food, nutrition, safe water and healthy eating, especially with limited ingredients. Please ask me something about those.
chat.rateLimited: You have asked many questions in a short time. Please wait a little and try again.
chat.unavailable: The assistant is not available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
chat.invalidRequest: The question could not be read. Please write a shorter question and try again.
chat.refusal: I cannot answer this. Please ask a doctor or a nutrition worker.
chat.truncated: The answer was cut short. Ask me to continue or to be more specific.
chat.disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. For a health problem, ask a doctor.
